set.name: Runeterra Reforged

overview.Name: Runeterra Reforged
overview.Live dates: June 14, 2023 to September 12, 2023 (replaced by mid-set 9.5 Horizonbound in patch 13.18)
overview.Theme: The regions of Runeterra (League of Legends lore). Origins are regions such as Demacia, Noxus, Ionia, Shurima, Zaun.

mechanics: Region Portals replaced the opening carousel. Three portals appear at the start; each player moves to one to vote; one portal is picked at random with votes weighting the odds. The chosen portal sets a rule for the whole lobby. Riot listed at least 28 portals at launch; this file lists every portal in the MetaTFT data (62 rows, including variants). Examples from Riot: Zaun (no interest, flat 3 gold per round from 2-1), Piltover (augments disabled), Shurima (4-7 raptors replaced by a Treasure Armory rerollable for 2 gold), Shadow Isles (collect souls from deaths, loot per stage).

Legends: before queueing, the player picks one of 15 Legends. A Legend shapes the leftmost of the three augment choices at each augment round. Riot: the 2-1 Legend augment is equal power to its tier; the 3-2 and 4-2 Legend augments are slightly weaker than same-tier augments.
Augment rerolls changed: each augment card can be rerolled individually; Riot listed 18 total augment rerolls per game. Over 100 new augments were added.

Unique champions: Ryze (Wanderer) has a different spell depending on the Region Portal the lobby voted for (this file lists all 11 Ryze variants). Heimerdinger (Technogenius) gives a placeable Apex Turret with 3 upgrade slots; turret upgrades appear in the shop for 6 gold.
Set-specific items in data: Chempunk mods (Zaun), Piltover charges, Crown of Demacia, Darkin blade (World Ender), Baron's Head, Scroll of Traits, Masterwork Upgrade.
Shimmerscale items from Set 7 and radiant items appear in the item pool through augments and portals.

source.line: CommunityDragon `https://raw.communitydragon.org/13.17/cdragon/tft/en_us.json` (set data `TFTSet9`) for champions, stats, abilities, traits, items and augments.
